hero.title: OrchID
hero.subtitle: NCD
hero.description: An end-to-end research ecosystem built at the University of Naples Federico II, bridging the gap between field botany and state-of-the-art Computer Vision.

scientific.title: Scientific Context
scientific.content1: The Ophrys genus represents one of the most complex and fascinating cases of biological evolution driven by pollinators. These orchids utilize 'sexual deception,' emitting pheromones and mimicking the morphology of insects to attract males of specific species.
scientific.content2: This extreme specialization leads to incredible morphological variability and frequent hybridization, making field identification extremely difficult even for expert botanists. The OrchID project was born to provide objective computational tools capable of supporting biodiversity monitoring.

vectorSpace.title: Latent Embedding Space
vectorSpace.description: One of the primary goals of this research is the construction of a high-dimensional vector space (embedding space) where orchid images are mapped based on their morphological features. This serves as the foundation for similarity search and outlier detection.

ncd.title: Novel Class Discovery (NCD)
ncd.description: Traditional classifiers assume a 'closed world.' Our research focuses on Novel Class Discovery, the ability of the model to recognize species it has never seen during training, identifying 'novel' entities in the wild.

experiment6.title: Experiment Analysis: Serie 6
experiment6.description: Experiment 6 is the cornerstone of our current results. After identifying leakage in previous series, Exp 6 provides a realistic assessment of model generalization.
experiment6.resnetDesc: Our ResNet50 model reached a peak Val F1-Score of 0.905, demonstrating that standard architectures are still highly competitive.
experiment6.vitDesc: DINOv2-Base is our current champion, achieving a mean Val F1-Score of 0.914 ± 0.012. It shows exceptional robustness to occlusions and clutter in field photos.
